mapper.select: select mn.* from Pc_Construction_Area_Dtl mn where mn.Pc_Id=#{pcId} order by mn.Cat_Sort asc
select mn.* from Pc_Sources_Funds mn where mn.Pc_Id=#{pcId} order by mn.Fs_Sort asc
select mn.* from Pc_Inv_Detail mn where mn.Pc_Id=#{pcId} order by mn.Fs_Sort asc

select c1.C_Name as pConstructionUnitName, c2.C_Name as pAgentConstructionUnitName, c3.C_Name as pDesignAndConstructionIntegrationUnitName, c1.C_Abbreviation as pConsAbbName, c2.C_Abbreviation as pAgentConsAbbName, c3.C_Abbreviation as pDesConsIntegAbbName, d.D_Name as pCompetentDepartmentName, parent.P_Name as pParentName, parent.P_code as pParentCode, f.file_relation_id as fileRelationId,
from Pre_Project_Change mn left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_Id=mn.P_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=mn.P_Agent_Construction_Unit left join SYS_Company c3 on c3.C_Id=mn.P_Design_And_Construction_Integration_Unit left join SYS_Department d on mn.P_Competent_Department=d.D_Id left join Pre_Project parent on parent.P_ID=mn.P_Parent_ID left join Sys_File f on f.FileID=mn.Pc_ID where mn.Pc_Id=#{pcId}
